resources.string: Centered Info and Menu buttons and compact, optically balanced controls refine the main view.
Reticle placement and information-panel spacing adapt more consistently to portrait and landscape.
The Location position editor has a full-width map, side-by-side coordinates and consistent action buttons.
Estimated weather is visible in the position editor, and language choices are sorted by language code.
Object rows, filter counts and bulk-selection controls remain stable during automatic updates.
Photo and panorama headers show the app logo; capture symbols use improved day/night contrast.
